Inter-item r: p3 block 0.54-0.73, p2 with p3_k 0.26-0.47 (positive throughout: both scales run 1 = most). P.2 and P.3 carry no filter (the only filters precede them: A0 and NACIONALIDAD screen out non-voters and foreign nationals before the interview proper, so every interviewee was asked both). SHAPE: P.2 is a standalone question and P.3 is a four-row grid with its own read-aloud question, so -- following the spain_2024_values_meaning (batch_324) and spain_2016_cooperation_interest (batch_323) precedent for a standalone question stacked with a grid -- instructions is blank, p2 sits in section _1 with its full question as item_text and blank section_prompt, and the P.3 question is the section_prompt of section _2 with the four row labels as item_text. The P.3 question is printed on one line ending 'o' and continued 'nada...?' on the next; joined with a space, ellipsis kept as printed. No ENTREVISTADOR/A directions or CATI fill tokens in P.2 or P.3. text_source=study_materials: all Spanish from cues3566.pdf and the ES3566/.sav labels, which agree.
